title: Wire-type single-sourcing manifest (IC1, Train A)
description: Script-readable map of every shared wire concept to its ONE compiled Core authority. The Train B generator (Alembic side, P0 §8) reads this manifest to emit AlembicDashboard/src/generated/api-types.ts; test/WireTypeManifest.test.ts keeps the runtime-verifiable member lists in sync with the compiled sources. Glossary terms for the generated artifact header come from docs/semantic-glossary.md.

knowledgeEntryWire.note: 60+-field wire contract. Known Dashboard hand-copy drift (types.ts:697): missing usageGuide, agentNotes typed string[] instead of string — Train B's generated artifact replaces that copy.

candidateStates.locatorRuling: P0 OPEN item CLOSED (Train A, 2026-06-12): NO separate candidate-status enum exists anywhere in the space. Candidates are knowledge entries whose lifecycle is in CANDIDATE_STATES — the unified lifecycle state machine is the single authority. Located duplications to retire via Train B: AlembicDashboard src/types.ts:629 hand-copies KnowledgeLifecycle; src/api.ts:3103 hardcodes new Set(['pending','staging']); src/types.ts:812 hand-copies ProposalStatus.

proposalStatus.note: Separate state machine from knowledge lifecycle (evolution proposals).

failureKinds.note: 16 kinds; the problem envelope authority. Full per-repo adoption map lives in the error registry (IC4).

jobKinds.note: Already singular: Alembic aliases it as DAEMON_JOB_KINDS (lib/daemon/RuntimeBoundary.ts); no consumer defines its own copy.
